Phase A: append_jsonl atomic primitive + index-group lock order + verify_jsonl unconditional + JSONL strict readers + frozen no-write writer-side coverage + report_ingestion strict. Phase B: release_claim lease-token (REAL CI BUG) + workflow mock boolean (REAL CI BUG) + claim metadata fused-return + list_requests derived state + planner hook single-claim with token/metadata env separation. Phase C: planner-role auto-bridge + content_hash alias + CLI issue-challenger strict fields (ACTIVE TypeError) + cross-review pair check + bridge retry append-only ledger with BRIDGE_REQUIRED_ROLES + crash recovery. Phase D: validation_runs.jsonl + scope drift gate + PR change_id + auto-merge triple gate + no-risk evidence enforcement + apply gate empty-diff reject. Phase E (10 items): spine cache status-aware + synthetic sandbox PR block + skill genesis chain + skill_birth routing + memory canonical path + materialize_agent_draft gate + FATES recompute via canonical_path + self-output taxonomy + skill_genesis surface + tool DRAFT/SANDBOX/ARCHIVED matrix. Phase G (NEW): worker state by assignment_id + claims-SSoT reducer with recorded_at + worker submit lease-bound+active-claim+lease-expiry+multi-active corruption+provenance. evidences.summary: Phase A.1 — `append_jsonl` no per-file lock + no fsync. Plus `_refresh_adjacent_index → write_index → _atomic_write_text` chain writes a SINGLE shared `integrity_index.json` covering 4 tools + 8 aria-memory ledgers; per-file locks don't protect shared index. Plus `tmp.replace(path)` without fsync.

Phase A.2 — `verify_jsonl` invariants conditional (`if expected:`); rows without `ledger_hash` pass silently. `rewrite_jsonl:64-75` no lock no fsync. Test fixtures `feedback_v1/cycles.jsonl + runs.jsonl + health.jsonl` hashless.

Phase B.1 (REAL CI BUG) — `release_claim` no `lease_token` param. CLI `agent release` lacks `--lease-token-from-env`. `ci_executor._release_claim` shells out with the missing arg → today's CI fails on every fail-fast branch.
Phase B.2 (REAL CI BUG) — `_is_mock_mode` accepts only literal `"1"`. Workflow default `'true'` → live-Claude branch → ClaudeCodeUnavailable → exit 1.
Phase B.4 — `list_agent_invocation_requests` raw `row.state` filter, not lifecycle `derive_request_state`. CLAIMED-derived rows still match `--state pending`.

Phase C.3 (ACTIVE TypeError) — `convergent-plan issue-challenger` CLI registers only `--plan-id + --round-number`; bridge function requires 3 additional keyword-only args. Today's CLI raises TypeError before GovernanceError.

Phase C.1 + C.5 — `submit_claim_result` bridges only judge + supporting roles; planner roles (primary_plan/challenger_plan/cross_review) fall through. Bridge errors recorded but result row stays ACCEPTED; replay idempotent skips bridge → permanent 'accepted-but-unbridged'.
Phase D.5 — enforced-mode + `risk_types == []` → matrix vacuously passes + `_check_run_pass_layer` NEVER invoked. Zero-evidence pass for no-risk changes under enforced mode.
Phase D.6 — `gate_apply_action` rejects only `diff_text is None`; empty string passes. `_read_diff_from_action:217` can return empty string → gate accepts → suppression scanner runs on zero content.

Phase D.4 — `merge_if_green` only gates `head_sha == latest_head_sha` (Plan 024 §B-6 force-push detection). Missing: (a) PR head_sha == change.commit_sha for change_id, (b) change_validated row exists, (c) validation_run_refs log_hash verified. 1 of 3 enterprise gates present today.
Phase E.1 — `_is_fresh` checks only repo_state_id + age; cached rows with `status: failed | crash` are reused as fresh because the status field is not inspected at cache-reuse time.
Phase E.2 + E.6 — `approve_agent_pr` checks only `sandbox.decision == 'pass'`; synthetic sandbox flows through. `materialize_agent_draft:292-337` does no sandbox decision check at all (E.6).
Phase E.3 — skill_genesis writes draft / sandbox / materialize rows without predecessor validation. Orphan rows accepted; `materialize_skill` never checks sandbox decision.

Phase E.5 + E.7 + E.8 — `validate_repo_evidence:179-189` lexical startswith (traversal defeats). `_evidence_hashes:633` trusts persisted FATES hash without recompute. `SELF_OUTPUT_PREFIXES:14` missing aria-findings/aria-debts/aria-proposals.
Phase E.10 — `transition_tool` ACTIVE-target block covers only CALIBRATE + SHADOW; DRAFT/SANDBOX/ARCHIVED → ACTIVE silent succeed if 4 proofs happen to pass.

Phase F.1 — Plan 025 §D + §E shipped discrete daemons (planner-dispatch + worker-scheduler) but no unified orchestrator binding `cycle → reflection_queue → planner_requests → results → validation → apply → PR → merge → next_cycle`. Operator must manually couple legs.

Phase G — `_latest_request_states` pe-keyed (G.1 ambiguous on re-dispatch); worker-results + verification-results rows carry NO timestamp (G.2 reducer fold broken); `submit_worker_result:23-32` has no `lease_token` param (G.3 asymmetric vs agent path).
